scope: Exact-commit pre-release incremental QA of eight management/evidence files; no remote, migration, deployment or production verification

checks.name: exact SHA ancestry and clean tree
checks.actual: HEAD equals new SHA; prior release and accepted fix are ancestors; git diff --check passes; working tree clean.

checks.name: complete eight-file diff
checks.actual: Only backlog, two contracts, registry and four release evidence files changed; no runtime or test files.

checks.name: fixed handler bytes unchanged
checks.actual: Route, focused test, request-access resolver and CSV helper identical across fix, prior release and final commit.

checks.name: authorization scope and unit separation
checks.actual: User authorization source names this CSV repair and GitHub-first deployment; new runtime unit depends on the local-only JRN report; contract explicitly preserves production FAIL until real smoke.

checks.name: prior independent evidence retained
checks.actual: Three prior preflight originals archived byte for byte; accepted local repair PASS and original production QA FAIL remain intact.

checks.name: original production failure open
checks.actual: Registry journeyFailure remains OPEN/FAIL_OPEN with authorization now true, and original QA wrapper remains FAIL.

authorizationAnnotation.requiredBeforeManifest: Do not copy source JSON verbatim into schema-2 authorization. Create a truthful final-SHA authorization record for the runtime manifest, citing the user grant and explaining the earlier provisional SHA annotation; independent production QA must check it. If exact-SHA authorization cannot be substantiated, stop before deploy.

modelSelection.reason: Only eight bounded management/evidence files changed after prior accepted handler and 179-file archive review.
modelSelection.escalationCondition: Any runtime difference or unclear authorization/authentication semantics fails this bounded review and returns to controller for high-effort reassessment.

limits: This PASS is for local release preflight and scope separation only. Final schema-2 authorization, remote exact-SHA verification, no-migration proof, deployment and production smoke remain future gates.
Original production anonymous batch CSV 500 remains OPEN. Paid own/foreign CSV and cross-workspace write remain untested.
Registry and authorization-source releaseSha fields still name the prior planned commit; they cannot be treated as final-SHA manifest proof.
If another commit changes the final release SHA, repeat focused incremental QA against that exact SHA.
